pointers.sentence: `SessionMiddleware.__init__` imports the module that `SESSION_ENGINE` names and keeps the store class that module defines (`django/contrib/sessions/middleware.py:SessionMiddleware.__init__`).

`SessionMiddleware.process_request` reads the cookie that `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` names, `"sessionid"` by default, and sets `HttpRequest.session` to a new store made with its value, or with `None` when the request has no such cookie (`django/contrib/sessions/middleware.py:SessionMiddleware.process_request`).

`MiddlewareMixin.__call__` always runs `process_request` before the layers inside, so in the chain what trips the guard is code inside that deleted `HttpRequest.session` or replaced it with an object without these attributes, or an engine whose store lacks them; in a run whose view deleted it, the response came back with no cookie and no `"Vary"` (`django/contrib/sessions/middleware.py:SessionMiddleware.process_response`).
`is_empty` is true when the store has no key and its data, if it has loaded any, is an empty dictionary (`django/contrib/sessions/backends/base.py:SessionBase.is_empty`).
The deleted cookie gets the path, domain and SameSite that the settings give the cookie when it is set ([Cookies](../http/cookies.md)) (`django/http/response.py:HttpResponseBase.delete_cookie`).

`"Cookie"` goes into `"Vary"` by `patch_vary_headers` whenever the session was accessed and whenever the cookie is set or deleted: a response made from a session depends on the `"Cookie"` header that brought its key, and `"Vary"` tells a cache so ([Cache headers and conditional requests: `django/utils/cache.py`](../services/http-caching.md)) (`django/utils/cache.py:patch_vary_headers`).

The save of a session without a key makes one: at /port/ in a run, the backend asked whether a new key was taken, then inserted the row (`django/contrib/sessions/middleware.py:SessionMiddleware.process_response`).
A browser-length session's row is still stored to expire after `SESSION_COOKIE_AGE`: two weeks ahead, at a login in a run (`django/contrib/sessions/backends/base.py:SessionBase.get_expiry_date`).

Every backend but the signed-cookie one then raises `UpdateError`, which the middleware raises again as this subclass of `BadRequest` (`django/contrib/sessions/middleware.py:SessionMiddleware.process_response`, `django/contrib/sessions/exceptions.py:SessionInterrupted`, `django/contrib/sessions/backends/db.py:SessionStore.save`).
